while:

cmp esi,[edi+1C]

jl next2

jg next2
mov [edx+28],3
next2:

ja while

pop eax
pop esi
pop edx

cmp [edi+8],320
jna next3
push edi
call 4679B0
next3:

mov ecx,[edi]

exit:
jmp returnhere
